audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft restored English of 2 Chronicles 31 aligned to supplied Hebrew; retains divine name YHWH and preserves name-variant and administrative details for witness review.

verses.restored: And when all this was completed, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah; they broke the standing-stones, cut down the asherim, and broke down the high places and the altars from all Judah and Benjamin, even in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they utterly destroyed them. Then all the children of Israel returned, each to his possession, into their cities.

familiar.text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

modern.text: When all this had ended, the Israelites in attendance went out to the cities of Judah and broke up the sacred pillars, chopped down the Asherah poles, and tore down the high places and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the Israelites returned to their cities, each to his own property.

original.text: וּכְכַלּ֣וֹת כָּל זֹ֗את יָצְא֨וּ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הַֽנִּמְצְאִים֮ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ וַיְשַׁבְּר֣וּ הַמַּצֵּב֣וֹת וַיְגַדְּע֣וּ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֡ים וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ אֶת הַ֠בָּמוֹת וְאֶת הַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֞ת מִכָּל יְהוּדָ֧ה וּבִנְיָמִ֛ן וּבְאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עַד לְכַלֵּ֑ה וַיָּשׁ֜וּבוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לַאֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ לְעָרֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites according to their divisions, each man according to his service—priests and Levites for olah (burnt offerings) and for shelamim (peace/thank offerings), to minister and to give thanks and to praise at the gateways of the tents of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

modern.text: Hezekiah reestablished the divisions of the priests and Levites—each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites—for the burnt offerings and peace offerings, for ministry, for giving thanks, and for singing praises at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling. Contributions for Worship

original.text: וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד יְחִזְקִיָּ֡הוּ אֶת מַחְלְק֣וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּם עַֽל מַחְלְקוֹתָ֞ם אִ֣ישׁ כְּפִ֣י עֲבֹדָת֗וֹ לַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְלַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְעֹלָ֖ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְשָׁרֵת֙ וּלְהֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֖י מַחֲנ֥וֹת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He appointed also the king’s minah (portion) from his wealth for the burnt offerings—to present for the morning and evening olot, for the sabbaths and the new moons and the appointed feasts, as written in the law of YHWH.

familiar.text: He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD.

modern.text: The king contributed from his own possessions for the regular morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, as written in the Law of the LORD.

original.text: וּמְנָת֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ מִן רְכוּשׁ֜וֹ לָעֹל֗וֹת לְעֹלוֹת֙ הַבֹּ֣קֶר וְהָעֶ֔רֶב וְהָ֣עֹל֔וֹת לַשַּׁבָּת֖וֹת וְלֶחֳדָשִׁ֣ים וְלַמֹּעֲדִ֑ים כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moreover he commanded the people who dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion for the priests and the Levites, that they might be strengthened in the law of YHWH.

familiar.text: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.

modern.text: Moreover, he commanded the people living in Jerusalem to make a contribution for the priests and Levites so that they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָעָם֙ לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָתֵ֕ת מְנָ֥ת הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְמַ֥עַן יֶחֶזְק֖וּ בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: And when the word went forth, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of d'gan (grain), tirosh (wine), yitzhar (oil), and devash (honey), and of all the yield of the field; and the tithe of all things they brought in abundantly.

familiar.text: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

modern.text: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously provided the firstfruits of the grain, new wine, oil, and honey, and of all the produce of the field, and they brought in an abundance—a tithe of everything.

original.text: וְכִפְרֹ֣ץ הַדָּבָ֗ר הִרְבּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּגָ֗ן תִּיר֤וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְכֹ֖ל תְּבוּאַ֣ת שָׂדֶ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֥ר הַכֹּ֛ל לָרֹ֖ב הֵבִֽיאוּ

verses.restored: And the children of Israel and of Judah who dwelt in the cities of Judah also brought the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things, consecrated to YHWH their God; and they laid them by heaps.

familiar.text: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.

modern.text: And the Israelites and Judahites who lived in the cities of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things consecrated to the LORD their God, and they laid them in large heaps.

original.text: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה הַיּֽוֹשְׁבִים֮ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ גַּם הֵ֗ם מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן וּמַעְשַׂ֣ר קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הֵבִ֕יאוּ וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ עֲרֵמ֥וֹת עֲרֵמֽוֹת

verses.restored: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps; and in the seventh month they finished them.

familiar.text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

modern.text: In the third month they began building up the heaps, and they finished in the seventh month.

original.text: בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הָעֲרֵמ֖וֹת לְיִסּ֑וֹד וּבַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י כִּלּֽוּ

verses.restored: Then Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, and blessed YHWH and His people Israel.

familiar.text: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.

modern.text: When Hezekiah and his officials came and viewed the heaps, they blessed the LORD and His people Israel.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ וְהַשָּׂרִ֔ים וַיִּרְא֖וּ אֶת הָעֲרֵמ֑וֹת וַֽיְבָרֲכוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Then Hezekiah inquired of the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

familiar.text: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

modern.text: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and Levites about the heaps,

original.text: וַיִּדְרֹ֣שׁ יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֛ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם עַל הָעֲרֵמֽוֹת

verses.restored: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, saying: 'From the time the offerings began to be brought into the house of YHWH we have had enough and have been filled, and have left much; for YHWH has blessed His people; and that which is left is this great store.'

familiar.text: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

notes.title: short
notes.body: כְּנַעַנְיָהוּ/כונניהו variant appears in Hebrew; review name forms.

modern.text: and Azariah, the chief priest of the household of Zadok, answered him, “Since the people began to bring their contributions into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and there is plenty left over, because the LORD has blessed His people; this great abundance is what is left over.” Hezekiah Organizes the Priests

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו עֲזַרְיָ֧הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הָרֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֣ית צָד֑וֹק וַ֠יֹּאמֶר מֵהָחֵ֨ל הַתְּרוּמָ֜ה לָבִ֣יא בֵית יְהוָ֗ה אָכ֨וֹל וְשָׂב֤וֹעַ וְהוֹתֵר֙ עַד לָר֔וֹב כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֣ךְ אֶת עַמּ֔וֹ וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר אֶת הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Then Hezekiah commanded that chambers be prepared in the house of YHWH; and they prepared them.

familiar.text: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them,

modern.text: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare storerooms in the house of the LORD, and they did so.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ לְהָכִ֧ין לְשָׁכ֛וֹת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּכִֽינוּ

verses.restored: They brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully; over them Cononiah the Levite was ruler (kananyahu), and Shimei his brother was next.

familiar.text: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Hebrew shows כונניהו (Cononiah) with alternate form כָּנַנְיָהוּ; flag for witness check.

modern.text: And they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes, and dedicated gifts. Conaniah the Levite was the officer in charge of them, and his brother Shimei was second.

original.text: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת הַתְּרוּמָ֧ה וְהַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֛ר וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם נָגִיד֙ כונניהו הַלֵּוִ֔י וְשִׁמְעִ֥י אָחִ֖יהוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה

verses.restored: And Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were officers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother—by the king’s command and by Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

familiar.text: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

modern.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the authority of Conaniah and his brother Shimei, by appointment of King Hezekiah and of Azariah the chief official of the house of God.

original.text: וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וַ֠עֲזַזְיָהוּ וְנַ֨חַת וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֜ל וִֽירִימ֤וֹת וְיוֹזָבָד֙ וֶאֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְיִסְמַכְיָ֔הוּ וּמַ֖חַת וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ פְּקִידִ֗ים מִיַּ֤ד כונניהו וְשִׁמְעִ֣י אָחִ֔יו בְּמִפְקַד֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ נְגִ֥יד בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: And Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God to distribute the oblations of YHWH and the most holy things.

familiar.text: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.

modern.text: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions to the LORD and the consecrated gifts.

original.text: וְקוֹרֵ֨א בֶן יִמְנָ֤ה הַלֵּוִי֙ הַשּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַמִּזְרָ֔חָה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים לָתֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְקָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: And next to him were Eden, Minyamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah in the cities of the priests, in their regular office, to give to their brothers by courses, both to the great and to the small.

familiar.text: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

modern.text: Under his authority, Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah faithfully distributed portions to their fellow priests in their cities, according to their divisions, old and young alike.

original.text: וְעַל יָד֡וֹ עֵ֣דֶן וּ֠מִנְיָמִן וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֧הוּ וּשְׁכַנְיָ֛הוּ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה לָתֵ֤ת לַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ בְּמַחְלְק֔וֹת כַּגָּד֖וֹל כַּקָּטָֽן

verses.restored: Beside their genealogies of males from three years old and upward: to every one who entered the house of YHWH they were to give his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses.

familiar.text: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

modern.text: In addition, they distributed portions to the males registered by genealogy who were three years of age or older—to all who would enter the house of the LORD for their daily duties for service in the responsibilities of their divisions—

original.text: מִלְּבַ֞ד הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לִזְכָרִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁל֤וֹשׁ שָׁנִים֙ וּלְמַ֔עְלָה לְכָל הַבָּ֥א לְבֵית יְהוָ֖ה לִדְבַר י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ לַעֲב֣וֹדָתָ֔ם בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: And the priests were assigned according to the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward in their charges by their courses.

familiar.text: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

modern.text: and to the priests enrolled according to their families in the genealogy, as well as to the Levites twenty years of age or older, according to their duties and divisions.

original.text: וְאֵ֨ת הִתְיַחֵ֤שׂ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑עְלָה בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: And they apportioned also for all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters throughout the congregation; for in their regular office they sanctified themselves to holiness.

familiar.text: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

modern.text: The genealogy included all the little ones, wives, sons, and daughters in the whole assembly. For they had faithfully consecrated themselves as holy.

original.text: וּלְהִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּכָל טַפָּ֧ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֥ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָתָ֖ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: And of the sons of Aaron the priests who were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every city, men named by name were to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all reckoned among the Levites.

familiar.text: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

modern.text: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farmlands around each of their cities or in any other city, men were designated by name to distribute a portion to every male among the priests and to every Levite listed by the genealogies.

original.text: וְלִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים בִּשְׂדֵ֨י מִגְרַ֤שׁ עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּכָל עִ֣יר וָעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לָתֵ֣ת מָנ֗וֹת לְכָל זָכָר֙ בַּכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּלְכָל הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ בַּלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: So Hezekiah did throughout all Judah; he did what was good, right, and true before YHWH his God.

familiar.text: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

modern.text: So this is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah. He did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God.

original.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ כָּזֹ֛את יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכָל יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ וְהָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו

verses.restored: And in all the works that he began in the service of the house of God, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart; and he prospered.

familiar.text: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

modern.text: He was diligent in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law and the commandments, in order to seek his God. And so he prospered.

original.text: וּבְכָֽל מַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֲשֶׁר הֵחֵ֣ל בַּעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וּבַתּוֹרָה֙ וּבַמִּצְוָ֔ה לִדְרֹ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהָ֑יו בְּכָל לְבָב֥וֹ עָשָׂ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחַ

translation_notes: Rendered Hebrew יהוה as YHWH throughout. Kept Israelite cultic terms (e.g., asherim, olah, minah) as transliterations with glosses where useful.
